definitions.explanation: A person selected to represent a team or participate in a competition, especially in sports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧{選手|せんしゅ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧{選手|せんしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become an Olympic athlete.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I retired from my athletic career.
examples.notes: 選手生活 = career as an athlete

notes:
USAGE: {選手|せんしゅ} refers to athletes or players who compete in sports or games. The word contains ⟦{選|せん}→選：09879_sen⟧ (select) because these are people chosen to represent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧/⟦サッカー→サッカー：04726_sakkaa⟧/⟦テニス→テニス：01784_tenisu⟧{選手|せんしゅ} (baseball/soccer/tennis player)
- ⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧{選手|せんしゅ} (representative player)
- ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧{選手|せんしゅ} (professional athlete)
- ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}{権|けん}→選手権：14432_senshuken⟧ (championship)
- {選手|せんしゅ}⟦{生命|せいめい}→生命：03296_seimei⟧ (athletic career)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {選手|せんしゅ} - athlete, player (competitive)
- ⟦プレイヤー→プレイヤー：15082_pureiyaa⟧ - player (general, including non-competitive)
- ⟦{競技者|きょうぎしゃ}→競技者：noentry⟧ - competitor (formal)
